body:
Next native Serenity slice: sun shafts, matching cloud shadows, temporal exposure.

TOGGLE_VL_FOG now raymarches HDR+depth toward the engine sun (camera UBO lightDirection at 208) and uses reconstructed world distance for bloomy fog instead of raw depth. Exposure_Speed mixes the spatial meter with last frame's swapchain history (hybrid binding 4). Sky clouds and ground cloud shadows share SerenityCloudNoise.glsl.

Still gaps: voxel LPV, GPU histogram, layered cloud shadow maps, water volume refraction, closest-velocity motion vectors. Cube Test fully relinked. Forge not touched.
